title: Finite abelian bundle sections on a profinite slice
statement: Use the size convention [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $P$ be a profinite space and let $T$ be a topological commutative ring. On $\operatorname{Prof}/P$ with finite jointly surjective covers put $R_T=(\underline T)|_P$, the restriction of the continuous-function ring sheaf [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring], so $R_T(Q\to P)=C(Q,T)$. A finite locally constant abelian bundle on $P$ is specified by a natural number $n$, a locally constant map $c:P\to\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ and finite abelian groups $G_i$. Its total space is $\coprod_i c^{-1}(i)\times G_i$, with each group discrete, mapping to $P$ by projection. For $a:Q\to P$, define its group of continuous sections to be $\prod_i\operatorname{LC}(\{q\in Q:c(a(q))=i\},G_i)$, with pointwise addition. Restriction along $f:Q\to Q'$ over $P$ is precomposition on each piece. For a sheaf of modules $M$ over any ring sheaf on this slice [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], a section presentation is a family of additive equivalences between $M(Q)$ and these section groups commuting with every restriction. No condition is imposed on the action beyond the module-sheaf axioms.
